summary:
Turn 85 recorded the confirmed inert-feature finding at its coordinate, closing the last open discrepancy in the map.

State on entry. C12-transitive-skip-executes-commuting-command is confirmed in scope: with the flag enabled, the executor still refuses to run a committed instance whose command commutes with its uncommitted dependency, so the flag changes nothing and the documented transitive-conflict skipping does not occur.

Map update (accepted base version 17, two clarified objects). Behavior B8-scc-closure's transconf branch now records the confirmation — the block computes conflicts for every command pair and takes no action, and the check reproduced execution halting under the flag — with the launcher's `transconf = false` noted as the only reason the default deployment is unaffected. core_overview's transconf open detail was rewritten the same way and still names the interpretation question (whether the intended pruning was to drop the dependency from the closure or to relax the ready check). Both objects carry map_changes entries with sources and preserves explanations, so the closure walk, the ready checks, the formation/context/connection explanations and the other open details are unchanged, and no requirement, binding, edge, identity or claim moved.

Frontier at this point. Twelve claim families are settled: nine confirmed violations or consequences — C1 (recovery divergence, including its driven-proposal history), C2 (durable-record layout), C3 (applied-state divergence), C4 (NOOP-commit crash, with its constructed history), C6 (promoted-leader variant), C7 (dead accept-rejection path), C9 (recorder row, two scenarios), C10 (codec truncation, stream shift and receiver decode panic), C11 (startup probe), C12 (inert transitive-conflict skipping) — and two bounded no-violation protections (C5 owner-alive re-proposal, C8 executor timeout with its recovery-start follow-up). Two candidates remain paused with scoped resume conditions, one attribution issue remains structurally unresolvable on a superseded artifact, and the single item that cannot be exercised from an in-package harness is the reader-side reaction to a displaced stream. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
